t: Haoseh sukka tachat hailan o tachat haggag
s: Haoseh sukka tachat hailan o tachat haggag ubo k"a seipim: en adam yotze yede chobato ella besukka sheenah asuya ella letzel bilbad dugmat anene kabod, abal im hi asuya gam ledira dehaynu ladur bah biqbiut velo lehistopep betzillah bilbad, o sheasuya gam lehishtammesh bah tashmish shel tzeniut kegon leotzar, o shear tashmish shetztzarik laasoto bemaqom tzanua, o shehi asuya gam lemachseh ulemistor mizzerem umimmatar, kol sheenah asuya letzel bilbad — en zo sukka ella bayit, shehare habbayit hu meyuchad lekol debarim ellu, vehattora omra sukka velo bayit:

Utzerika shettehe hassukka tachat avir hashshamayim dugmat anene hakkabod, abal im asaah betok habbayit — pesula, lepi sheen tzel hassukka meshammesh kelum, sheap bilade hassekak yesh kan tzel mechamat tiqrat habbayit. Veken haddin beoseh sukka tachat hailan, o tachat shear debarim happesulim liskak sheyyitbaer besiman trl"a, ben sheqqodma hassukka laddabar happasul hammaahil aleha ben sheqqadam haddabar happasul lehassukka, shemmikkol maqom akshav en tzel hassukka meshammesh kelum, kevan shehatztzel haelyon alayv:

Lepikak apillu im tzel hassukka merubbeh mechammatah belo tzerup tzel haelyon kelal, dehaynu sheapillu im yinnatel tzel haelyon mikkan yihyeh tzillatah merubba mechammatah — ap al pi ken pesula. Vaapillu im tzel haelyon bilbad hu meat mizer, beinyan sheim yinnatel tzel hattachton dehaynu tzel hassekak sheal gabbe hassukka tihyeh chammato shel haelyon merubba mitztzillato — ap al pi ken pesula, dekevan shetztzel haelyon shehu pasul omed lemala — hare hu mebattel tzel hassekak shettachtayv kenegdo mammash, shehare eno meshammesh kelum, kevan shehaelyon metzel al maqom shehu metzel, ulepikak anu roim keillu nittal venechsar min tzel hassekak hakkasher keshiur tzel haelyon shemmetzel al hassukka, ukeillu haya hammaqom hazzeh shehaelyon metzel alayv meqom chamma, vetihyeh hassukka chammatah merubba mitztzillatah:

Abal im tzel hassukka hu merubbeh meod, beinyan sheapillu im yinnatel mimmenna keshiur tzel haelyon veyihyeh hammaqom shehaelyon metzel alayv meqom chamma veap al pi ken tihyeh hassukka tzillatah merubba mechammatah — keshera:

Vekol zeh keshehaya hassekak pasul lemala al hassekak kasher, abal im hayu meorabim zeh bazeh, kegon ilan shehaya metzel al hassukka shellematta mimmennu vehishpil anapayv lematta veereban, im hassekak hakkasher hu merubbeh harbeh min hassekak happasul hamorab bo — hare happasul nitbattel barob, ap im hinniach sekak hakkasher al sekak happasul — niqra irbub ubatel berob, veap al pi shessekak happasul hu nikkar ben hakkasher veeno meorab yapeh vehu yakol lahasiro mishsham — ap al pi ken hu batel. Veap al pi shebbekol issurin shebbattora im hu makkir et haissur veyakol lahasiro min hattaarobot eno batel apillu beelep, haynu sheasur leekol et hattaarobot, shello yipga begup haissur atzmo, shello nitbattel kevan sheyyakol lahasiro mishsham, abal kan eno neheneh kelal min haissur, shehare ap im yinnatel sekak happasul min hassukka yihyeh tzillatah merubba mechammatah mechamat sekak hakkasher, veen anu tzerikim lebattel et happasul berob ella kede shello yihyeh lo koach lipsol et hassekak hakkasher hamorab immo:

Abal im tzel hakkasher hu meat, beinyan sheim yinnatel tzel happasul min hassukka lo yehe tzillatah merubba mechammatah — hare hi pesula, lepi sheen tzel happasul mitztarep lehashlim hashshiur letzel hakkasher, kevan shello nitbattel adayin bittul gamur, shehare yakol lahasiro mishsham:

Vekol zeh keshehassekak happasul hamorab bakkasher hu beatzmo qal veqalush beinyan shechammato merubba mitztzillato, abal im tzillato merubba mechammato — en bittul berob moil lo shello yipsol et hassukka betzillo, kevan shetztzel hakkasher eno meshammesh kelum bemaqom shehappasul haya yakol lihyot metzel sham im lo nitareb sham, kevan shetztzillato merubba mechammato, velaken en hassukka keshera, ella im ken yesh bah sekak kasher harbeh kol kak ad sheim yinnatel mehassekak hakkasher keshiur hassekak happasul hamorab bo hayeta hassukka tzillatah merubba mechammatah:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshehakkasher vehappasul hen meorabin, o shehappasul hu munnach lematta min hakkasher, sheaz tzarik sheyyehe bakkasher rob keneged happasul kede lebattelo shello yipsol et hassukka betzillo, abal im hayu munnachin al hassukka kol echad veechad bipne atzmo zeh betzad zeh veenan meorabin kelal — en tzarik sheyyihyeh bakkasher rob keneged happasul, ella apillu im hem mechetza al mechetza gam ken — hassukka hi keshera, shekkak hi halaka lemosheh missinay kemo sheyyitbaer besiman trl"a, ayyen sham:

(Veyesh choleqin al kol zeh veomerim sheim happasul meorab bakkasher ushenehen hen min echad sheen happasul nikkar kelal, kegon haoseh sukkato tachat hailan vehishpil anpe hailan vehoridan lematta veereban im hassekak hattalush sheal gabbe hassukka, ap al pi shehu yakol lehasir et haissur, dehaynu sheyyagbiah et haanapim leiqqar hailan, mikkol maqom kol zeman shehen meorabin yachad veen nikkarin — hen betelim barob hakkasher, umitztorpin immo lehashlim leshiur tzillatah merubba mechammatah (delo kemo shennitbaer baddea harishona)*veap al pi shebbekol issurim shebbattora im yakol lehasir et haissur eno mitbattel berob, abal kan halaka lemosheh missinay hu sheen tzarik lihyot kol hassekak hatztzarik lassukka sheyyehe sekak kasher ella sheyyihyeh harob kasher, vehashshear ap al pi shehu pasul — ap al pi ken hassukka mitkashsheret bo, veim ken en al hammiut shem sekak pasul, ella gam hu chozer lihyot sekak kasher al yede rob hakkasher sheimmo. Ulepikak muttar leareb ulebattel sekak pasul bakkasher lekattechilla, mah sheen ken bishar issurin sheen mebattelin issur lekattechilla, lepi sheen shem issur kelal al hammiut happasul hamorab bakkasher.. Vehu sheyyehe sekak pasul hamorab daq veqalush beinyan sheyyehe chammato merubba mitztzillato, abal im tzillato merubba mechammato — eno mitztarep lehashlim leshiur tzillatah merubba mechammatah. Abal im hassukka hi tzillatah merubba mechammatah belo tzerup tzel sekak happasul — enah nipselet leolam mechamat tzel sekak happasul, ap al pi shetztzillato merubba mechammato:

Veim sekak happasul eno meorab im sekak hakkasher ella hu omed lemala umetzel al hakkasher, im en tzel hassukka merubbeh mechammatah belo tzerup tzel happasul, ap al pi shehappasul chammato merubba mitztzillato — ap al pi ken hare zo pesula, shehare sekak pasul mashlimah leshiurah, abal im tzillatah merubba mechammatah belo tzerup tzel happasul, ap al pi shehappasul tzillato merubba mechammato — hare zo keshera. Vehaiqqar kassebara harishona bekol zeh. Umikkol maqom, bishat haddechaq sheen lo sukka acheret, vegam i epshar lo letaqqen sukka zo ulehakshirah — yesh lismok al sebara haacharona, shello lehitbattel mimmitzvat sukka:
Im rotzeh liqtzotz et hailan lehakshiro lesikkuk — yitbaer besiman trk"t shetztzarik lenaanea et kol hailan, ayyen sham hattaam:

Muttar laasot sukka lematta babbayit tachat haggag shehesiru hareapim mimmennu kede laasot sukka, ap al pi shennisharu adayin haetzim o haqqorot shehareapim munnachim alehem. Umuttar lesheb tachat haetzim o haqqorot atzman ap al pi shehem sekak pasul, shehare lo niqbeu baggag leshem tzel bilbad ella kede latet alehem et hareapim, mikkol maqom kevan sheasa maaseh vehesir et hareapim leshem asiyyat sukka letzel — hare zeh keillu asa maaseh begup haetzim o haqqorot vehitqinam leshem sukka, shehare hem kesherim lesikkuk, shehen gedelim min haaretz veen meqabbelin tuma, veap al pi shehen mechubbarim — en bekak kelum, detalush ulebassop chibbero — kasher lesukka kemo sheyyitbaer besiman trk"t, vekevan shehen atzman kesherim liskak al yede maaseh zo veyakol lehanniach alehem od sekak kasher vehen mitztorpin im sekak zeh lehashlim leshiur tzillatah merubba mechammatah, velaken gam akshav shello hinniach hassekak alehem ella tachtehen lematta babbayit — muttar lesheb tachtehen mammash, kevan shehem sekak kasher:

Abal im lo hesir et hareapim kede laasot sham sukka ella kak hayeta miqqodem benuya belo gag, kevan shello asa shum maaseh baggag leshem asiyyat sukka letzel, im ken haetzim o haqqorot hen sekak pasul, vedino kedin sekak pasul hammaahil al gabbe hassekak kasher veal derek shennitbaer (perush shekkol sheen sekak hakkasher harbeh kol kak ad sheim yinnatel mimmennu keshiur sekak happasul hammetzel alayv yihyeh adayin tzel hassukka merubbeh mechammatah — pasul):

Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshemmesakkek tachat haggag, abal im mesakkek al gabbe haetzim o haqqorot, ap al pi shehen semukin zeh lazeh bepachot mishshelosha tepachim — hare zo keshera, veen omerim kan labud sheyyitztarepu kol haetzim veyihyu nechshabin keetz echad rachab missekak happasul yoter mearbaa tepachim shehu posel et hassukka kemo sheyyitbaer besiman trl"b, shekkevan shessekak kasher munnach ben etz lachabero — hu mapsiq benehem shello yitztarepu, veen omerim labud ella im ken en shum dabar mapsiq benetayim:
Veim muttar lesheb tachat haetzim — yitbaer besiman trl"a:

Im hinniach sekak pasul al gabbe hassukka shello haya aleha shum sekak veachar kak hinniach aleha sekak kasher al gabbe sekak happasul, veachar kak hesir sekak happasul meal gabbe hassukka venishar sekak haelyon hakkasher bilbaddo metzel al gabbe hassukka, veken haoseh dopnot hassukka tachat gag habbayit vehinniach sekak kasher al gabbe haggag veachar kak hesir et haggag mittachat hassekak hammunnach aleha — hare zo pesula, lepi shebbeshaa sheasa et hassukka, dehaynu beshaa shehinniach sekak hakkasher shehu iqqar hassukka, hayeta hassukka pesula mechamat sekak happasul shealeha, veachar kak keshehesir et happasul lo asa maaseh begup hassukka lehakshirah ella meeleha nitkashshera al yede hasarat happasul, vehattora omra "chag hassukkot taaseh leka vego'", velo min heasuy meelayv, shehaasiyya harishona shehayeta bipsul — enah nechshebet asiyya kelal:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Sheppesul hassukka haya mechamat atzmah, kegon banniddon sheamarnu shehinniach sekak hakkasher al gabbe happasul, sheggup hassukka dehaynu sekak hakkasher naasa bipsul mechamat atzmo, sheeno niqra sekak kelal kevan sheyyesh dabar mapsiq beno lehaddepanot, shehare en tzillo moil kelum. Abal im pesul hassukka hu mechamat dabar acher happosel otah, kegon haoseh sukkato tachat gag habbayit veachar shessikkekah kehilkatah hesir et haggag meal gabbe hassukka — hare zo keshera ap al pi shello asa maaseh begupah lehakshirah, kevan sheen pesula ella mechamat dabar acher dehaynu gag habbayit shemmetzel alayv velo mechamat atzmah, shehare hi mesukkeket kehilkatah biskak kasher hammunnach al gabbe dopnoteha, lekak kevan sheasa maaseh hakkasher bedabar happoselah, dehaynu shehesir et atze haggag shehayu qebuin sham leshem dira velo leshem tzel, ulepikak haya aleha shem sekak pasul, veakshav shehesiran mishsham legamre — niqra alehem shem sekak kasher, vaapillu al haetzim hannisharim niqra alehem shem sekak kasher kemo shebbearnu lemala, lepikak moil maaseh hakkasher zeh lehakshir et hassukka, kevan shello hayeta pesula ella mechamat haggag ukebar asa bo maaseh hakkasher:

Abal im lo asa maaseh hakkasher bedabar happoselah, kegon shello hesir et haggag legamre mimmeqom qebiuto, ella asa oto keen delet liptoach velisgor beet haggeshem, kevan shello hesiro mishsham legamre — en zeh maaseh gamur, ulepikak eno moil lehakshir et haetzim hannisharim velo et hassukka shennipsela mechammatah (kesheadayin lo niptecha haddelet vehayeta maahelet al hassukka):

Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshessikkek et hassukka qodem sheppatach et haddelet baggag, o apillu leachar sheppatach ella shebbishat hassikkuk hayeta haddelet segura vehayeta maahelet al hassukka, dekevan sheasiyyat hassukka hayeta bipsul — shub en moil lah mah sheachar kak patach et haddelet, kevan shello asa maaseh begup hassukka. Abal im beshaa shessikkekah hayeta haddelet petucha kehilkatah velo hayeta maahelet al hassukka, ap al pi sheachar kak segarah venipsela hassukka beshaa shehaddelet segura, mikkol maqom keshehu poteach et haddelet — hassukka chozeret leheksherah, kevan shettechillat asiyyatah hayeta bekashrut beshaa shehaddelet hayeta petucha:
Veim yesh ledelet zo tzirim shessoger upoteach bahem — hare hi kepetach gamur, umuttar lesograh ulepotchah beshabbat veyom tob, veen bazeh mishshum issur setira ubinyan:
Vetzarik sheyyizzaher shello yesheb tachteha leshem mitzvat sukka keshehi segura, sheaz hi pesula, veeno yotze yede chobato bishiba zo:
